# Visual Assets Tracker — RussiaHistory.org

**Purpose**: Master registry of all complementary images and videos for the scholarly Russian history website.  
**Philosophy**: Every asset is strictly atmospheric, mnemonic, or illustrative. None replace text, citations, or historiographical debate.  
**Standards**: All assets must pass historian review for historical accuracy and restraint before use. No sensationalism.

**Location of generated files**: `design-artifacts/generated-visuals/`

**Production Rule**: New assets are added only via PR + at least one specialist historian sign-off. Alt text + extended description are mandatory.

Very slowly and smoothly the red territory expands outward over time (Muscovite expansion, conquest of Kazan, Siberia, etc.) until it reaches the 1914 borders of the Russian Empire. Clean vector lines, subtle parchment texture background, soft elegant typography labels only for major rivers and key cities that appear at the right historical moment. No violence, no people, no dramatic music suggestion — purely informational and beautiful. Slow, contemplative pace. High contrast, suitable for a premium educational website. 16:9, 720p.
- **Generation Date**: 2026-05-27
- **Alt Text**: Animated map showing the gradual territorial expansion of the Grand Duchy of Moscow from 1462 to the Russian Empire of 1914.
- **Extended Description / Caption**: This short animation illustrates the remarkable, centuries-long growth of Muscovy from a small principality into one of the largest contiguous empires in history. Viewers should note the slow, steady nature of the expansion rather than any single dramatic conquest.
- **Historian Reviewer**: (Pending)
- **Status**: Generated
- **Notes**: First video asset. Excellent proof-of-concept for the restrained video approach.
